acceptanceCriteria: The 1.0.0-rc.1 full gate passes on the candidate that contains the fix.
The four tests that use the helper still pass on darwin/arm64.
`make cross-vet` passes for windows/amd64 and linux/arm64 on the root module and interop/cem01-go.
body: The 1.0.0-rc.1 release gate on 94ca556f (build 155) failed at cross-vet on 2026-09-27: `GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go vet ./...` reports cmd/corvint/host_adapter_test.go:515:20: undefined: workFinalInterruption. The helper and its workWitnessedDeadline type live in cmd/corvint/work_final_check_test.go, which is `//go:build unix`; d5a32c51 (decision 0082 load-flake fix) called it from the untagged host_adapter_test.go and local_completion_event_test.go. go test, go vet and every other runbook step passed.

completion.reason: Fixed in #290 (8e89bc42). make gate, including cross-vet for windows/amd64 and linux/arm64 on both modules, passed on candidate b967f6bbe33c5eba367a07d7eeb2bd1e372e9162 locally on darwin/arm64 and in hosted release-gates run 36351494735 on ubuntu-24.04 and macos-15.
